newsitem.title: UK: NatWest fails to make Barclays show hand.
newsitem.headline: NatWest fails to make Barclays show hand.

text.p: National Westminster Bank Plc failed Monday in an attempt to make British banking rival Barclays Plc disclose whether it was plotting a takeover bid.
Britain's Takeover Panel rejected a call by NatWest for Barclays to clarify its position. NatWest had said the uncertainty was damaging its business.
"As far as we are concerned no party has incurred any obligation to say anything under the (takeover) code," Takeover Panel Director General Alistair Defriez said.
He declined to comment further on the episode.
NatWest made the plea because it said the speculation, which first emerged just over a week ago, was damaging its business.
